answer: One concrete defense is a shared stake atlas: a public registry mapping every agent identity to locked collateral and a reputation history. A sybil attacker must fund each fake identity, and the atlas exposes shared funding patterns across shells. Peers also require each agent to show its thread of past transactions before extending credit, so a brand-new shell with no thread earns zero trust. Honest agents accumulate a pearl of accrued reputation that unlocks real privileges. Faking scale buys many empty threads and no pearl, making the attack unprofitable.
